name: PrintStash-API
post_parameters: /bin/sh -c "uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --no-access-log --proxy-headers"
description:
Backend for PrintStash, an open-source self-hosted 3D print library and G-code vault. Stores STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP/STP, G-code, and BGCODE files plus searchable metadata, thumbnails, collections, tags, revisions, print history, user access, printer connections, and backups. PrintStash adds content-hash duplicate detection, slicer metadata extraction, NAS/shared-volume indexing, G-code outcome tracking, printer workflows, measured usage, cost tracking, and optional Spoolman integration. Install with PrintStash-Frontend on the same user-defined Docker network named "printstash"; the frontend reaches this container as hostname "api". Set a strong VAULT_JWT_SECRET before first start. Configure local or S3-compatible storage and backups in the setup wizard.

-- IMPORTANT --
Create a user-defined Docker network named "printstash" first (Settings -> Docker Service -> Docker Networks -> "+ Add", or docker network create printstash). Install PrintStash-Frontend on the same network.

paths.name: Data (models/files)
paths.description: Private PrintStash storage. Must be a dedicated empty directory; never point this at an existing model, NAS, or Nextcloud folder. Add those later in Settings > External Libraries.

paths.name: Thumbnails
paths.description: Private generated-thumbnail storage. Must be a dedicated empty directory.

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: Optional. Only needed if you want to hit the API or /metrics directly. The frontend reaches it internally via the printstash network.

variables.name: Max upload (MB)
variables.description: Maximum upload size in MB. Keep in sync with the frontend NGINX_CLIENT_MAX_BODY_SIZE.

variables.name: JWT secret
variables.description: REQUIRED. A long random string used to sign auth tokens. Generate one, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

variables.name: Metrics token
variables.description: Optional. If set, the Prometheus /metrics endpoint requires this bearer token. Leave empty to keep it open on your LAN.

variables.name: VAULT_SETUP_MODE
variables.description: Set trusted_network for initial browser registration on a trusted network. Local Compose enables it. Existing accounts permanently close registration.
